rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a shopping cart in a shop or supermarket.

example.english: I pushed the shopping wagon over to buy groceries.
example.jyutping: ngo5 teoi1 zyu6 gau3 mat6 ce1 heoi3 maai5 sung3

rows.note: Use this for the all-purpose horse-drawn vehicle, including a wagon used to carry goods.

example.english: In ancient times, people used a horse-drawn wagon to carry goods.
example.jyutping: gu2 doi6 jan4 wui5 jung6 maa5 ce1 wan6 fo3

rows.note: Use this specifically for one carriage or wagon of a train rather than a road vehicle.

example.english: I got on the wagon at the back of the train.
example.traditional: 我上咗火車尾嗰節車卡。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng5 zo2 fo2 ce1 mei5 go2 zit3 ce1 kaa1
